leads.title: St Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha Constitution Order 2009
leads.documents: Bans discrimination based on sexual orientation across the territory; Article 21 defines 'discriminatory' treatment
leads.detail: Cited in Discrimination protections section with Article 21 quote including 'sexual orientation'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Commission for Equality and Human Rights Ordinance 2015
leads.documents: Establishes Equality and Human Rights Commission to monitor human rights, promote equality and investigate unlawful discrimination on grounds of sexual orientation or 'gender reassignment'; defines gender reassignment as intended/current/past process for reassigning sex including psychological identification with gender inconsistent with assigned sex at birth
leads.detail: Cited in Discrimination protections section with definitions quoted; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Marriage (Ascension) Ordinance, 2016
leads.documents: Legalizes same-sex marriage on Ascension Island effective 1 January 2017
leads.detail: Cited as approved by Ascension Island Council 31 May 2016 in 5-0 vote, signed by Governor and published in official gazette 20 June, commencement order 23 Dec 2016; no URL visible

leads.title: Marriages (Tristan da Cunha) Ordinance, 2017
leads.documents: Extends Marriage (Ascension) Ordinance, 2016 to Tristan da Cunha, legalizing same-sex marriage effective 4 August 2017
leads.detail: Cited as agreed by Tristan da Cunha Island Council 23 Feb 2017 after consultation with Governor, signed and gazetted 4 Aug; no URL visible

leads.title: Marriage Ordinance 2017 (Saint Helena)
leads.documents: Legalizes same-sex marriage on Saint Helena effective 20 December 2017
leads.detail: Cited as approved by Legislative Council 19 Dec 2017 by 9-2 vote after Executive Council and Social & Community Development Committee consultations, signed by Governor; first same-sex marriage 31 Dec 2018 noted; no URL visible

leads.title: Marriage Ordinance 1851 (Saint Helena) - prior law
leads.documents: Prior marriage law described as unclear on same-sex marriage, at issue in January 2017 same-sex marriage application
leads.detail: Cited in Saint Helena subsection re registrar seeking legal advice; no URL visible

leads.title: Saint Helena Supreme Court - same-sex marriage caveat referral (2017)
leads.documents: Chief Justice referral after two public caveats/objections to January 2017 same-sex marriage notice; documents enforcement/adjudication machinery
leads.detail: Cited as preliminary hearing 23 Feb 2017, parties given until July 2017 for arguments, later avoided by legislative action expected Jan 2018; no URL visible

leads.title: Saint Helena Welfare of Children Ordinance 2010
leads.documents: Allows single and married people to adopt regardless of sexual orientation; applies to Saint Helena and Tristan da Cunha
leads.detail: Cited in Adoption and parenting section; no URL visible

leads.title: Ascension Island Child Welfare Ordinance 2011
leads.documents: Allows single and married people to adopt regardless of sexual orientation; applies to Ascension Island
leads.detail: Cited in Adoption and parenting section; no URL visible

leads.title: 2006 UK Government report on adoptions
leads.documents: Reports there have been no adoptions in Saint Helena or Ascension Island for many years
leads.detail: Cited as 'According to a 2006 UK Government report'; no title or URL visible in text
